title: heap-use-after-free in sqlite3Fts5GetVarint
live_proof: backport filter: upstream fix adfb203a7d removes code still present in 3.22.0, and its own regression database (decoded from the fix's hex dump) reproduces on stock 3.22.0 under host ASan as heap-use-after-free in sqlite3Fts5GetVarint
object: an fts5 leaf-page buffer held by the segment iterator
lifetime_ender: the page is released while an iterator still refers to it, then the varint decoder reads it
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator: upstream's own regression image, run statement by statement through stock 3.22.0. Served from repro322_memfs.c rather than a real file -- ext/misc/memvfs.c cannot be used, it serves only the main database so the pager cannot create a rollback journal, and it takes its buffer as an integer in the URI, which on a capability machine is an untagged forged pointer
